description:
Advances: ancora.findings
Ready-for: investigate
Severity: Medium (calibrated; critical review 2026-09-05, consolidated F39, security M1).
Review-bar-override: changes what a semver-stable function returns; needs a contract decision, not a patch.

Symptom: a severity: off entry in .spec/config.yml destroys the finding before the hidden-by-source counters run (lib/ancora/severity.ex), so it appears in no bucket, while acks, trailers and (since ancora-gg8.9) config demotions are counted.
Evidence: reproduced on a scratch repo: suppressing change/uncovered_file left all hidden buckets at zero. The field-friction decision says every run counts what each suppression source hid.
Why now: the disclosure model has one uncounted lever. Question: is off a suppression source that should be counted, or is destroying the finding what off means?
title: Decide whether severity: off is a counted suppression source
